title: Amazing for attention management!
body:
I've tried other apps that do the same core thing (block addictive apps for a few seconds to help reduce the dopamine hit you get from opening the apps) - and this is the absolute best one. You can tell the developer cares about his users through being extremely thoughtful in the usability. I have three favourite functions: 
- Sometimes I need to switch to another app to copy and paste something or if I'm clicking a link (the link opens in browser) - you can set up one sec to allow you to go back to the original app again without having to go through another intervention. (This feature itself makes me continue to use this app - I have deleted other similar apps because the interventions were too annoying. Yes I want to be annoyed and that is the purpose but I don't want to be annoyed to the point of non-usability.)
- I also love the doom-scrolling intervention which allows me to continue using social media but forces me to go through another intervention and actively reminds me of how long I have been using it. (Didn't realise how useful this was until I set it up - after clicking 3 or 4x of 15 mins, I realised I had been mindlessly scrolling social media for too long.)
- Schedule time periods when certain apps are blocked. I set mine to my sleeping and productive hours.

I don't use this function but URLs are blockable too, not just apps. 

Set up was easy. The basic features are great and the pro features are absolutely worth it if you are serious about being in control of your life instead of letting apps dictate it for you.
